crossRefs.note: Everyone who is found will be thrust through. Everyone who is captured will fall by the sword.
For you have trusted in your wickedness. You have said, ‘No one sees me.’ Your wisdom and your knowledge has perverted…
Yahweh says, “Behold, a people comes from the north country. A great nation will be stirred up from the uttermost parts…
They take hold of bow and spear. They are cruel, and have no mercy. Their voice roars like the sea, and they ride on…
As when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and its neighbor cities,” says Yahweh, “so no man will dwell there, neither…
May the violence done to me and to my flesh be on Babylon!” the inhabitant of Zion will say; and, “May my blood be on…
Yahweh is a jealous God and avenges. Yahweh avenges and is full of wrath. Yahweh takes vengeance on his adversaries…
Who can stand before his indignation? Who can endure the fierceness of his anger? His wrath is poured out like fire…
“For, behold, the day comes, it burns as a furnace; and all the proud, and all who work wickedness, will be stubble…
The ten horns which you saw, and the beast, these will hate the prostitute, will make her desolate, will strip her…
For God has put in their hearts to do what he has in mind, to be of one mind, and to give their kingdom to the beast…
Therefore in one day her plagues will come: death, mourning, and famine; and she will be utterly burned with fire; for…
I saw an angel standing in the sun. He cried with a loud voice, saying to all the birds that fly in the sky, “Come! Be…
Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless Yahweh, my soul. Praise Yah!
But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it.

translations.web: Behold, the day of Yahweh comes, cruel, with wrath and fierce anger; to make the land a desolation, and to destroy its sinners out of it.
translations.bsb: Behold, the Day of the LORD is coming— cruel, with fury and burning anger— to make the earth a desolation and to destroy the sinners within it.
translations.kjv: Behold, the day of the LORD cometh, cruel both with wrath and fierce anger, to lay the land desolate: and he shall destroy the sinners
translations.asv: Behold, the day of Jehovah cometh, cruel, with wrath and fierce anger; to make the land a desolation, and to destroy the sinners thereof out of it.
